S.FORM: malumaingay a dawa i kasumamadan u kakitaan a tademaw nu Cong-kow u kakaydihay a sasang'a tu zikuc , sisa kauzipan a tademaw, nu Cong-kow caay kalasawad, mutesek ku kalilid tu palahad kacakat nu laylay nu Cong-kow, uzuma satu Si-han ci Cang-say a tademawan tayza i Si-yi mala, muculil tuyni "Si-lu" a zazanan a singanganay. makayza i Cong-kuw satipan nuwamisan milakui' tu talakaway Pa-mi-al a buyu' ciniza, katukuh ayzaay a Pakistan atu Iran, u sabaatay katukuh i O-cuo, mibuhat tu saculilan a laed nu Cung-si , lumaingay a dawa nu Cong-kow patayzaen i nutawan a kanatal, malecad aca u Cung, Si a lalangawan u saayaway a malalacal, mahiza u i labuay mahiza u baatay. == namakayniay a nasulitan nasakamuan atu natinengan ==
S.PHON: mar~ɾumaiŋaj a dawa i kasumamadan u kakitaan a tadəmaw nu ʦoŋ-kow u kakajdiħaj a sasaŋʔ~ʡa tu zikuʦ , sisa kauzipan a tadəmaw, nu ʦoŋ-kow ʦaaj kar~ɾasawad, mutəsək ku kar~ɾir~ɾid tu par~ɾaħad kaʦakat nu r~ɾajr~ɾaj nu ʦoŋ-kow, uzuma satu si-ħan ʦi ʦaŋ-saj a tadəmawan tajza i si-ji mar~ɾa, muʦur~ɾir~ɾ tujni "si-r~ɾu" a zazanan a siŋaŋanaj. makajza i ʦoŋ-kuw satipan nuwamisan mir~ɾakuiʔ~ʡ tu tar~ɾakawaj pa-mi-ar~ɾ a bujuʔ~ʡ ʦiniza, katukuħ ajzaaj a pakistan atu iran, u sabaataj katukuħ i o-ʦuo, mibuħat tu saʦur~ɾir~ɾan a r~ɾaəd nu ʦuŋ-si , r~ɾumaiŋaj a dawa nu ʦoŋ-kow patajzaən i nutawan a kanatar~ɾ, mar~ɾəʦad aʦa u ʦuŋ, si a r~ɾar~ɾaŋawan u saajawaj a mar~ɾar~ɾaʦar~ɾ, maħiza u i r~ɾabuaj maħiza u baataj. == namakajniaj a nasur~ɾitan nasakamuan atu natinəŋan ==
